## Reproduction

The agent's work, under your direction. Keep all code visible. Scope (from `reproducibilityReport.Rmd`): Study 1 descriptives and chi-square only (target 1).

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
d <- read_sav("Empathy Gap Study 1 data.sav")
dim(d)  # paper: N = 132 analyzed
```

```{r}
#| label: preprocess
d_tidy <- d |>
  select(ID, condition, exchangeinfo) |>
  mutate(
    condition = as_factor(condition),       # hypothetical / real
    exchangeinfo = as_factor(exchangeinfo)  # yes / no
  )

count(d_tidy, condition)  # paper: 61 hypothetical, 71 real
```

### Descriptive statistics

> Only 10 of the 61 participants in the hypothetical condition chose to exchange contact information with the unattractive potential date (16%). In contrast, 26 of the 71 participants in the real condition chose to exchange contact information (37%).

```{r}
#| label: descriptives
d_tidy |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_exchanged = sum(exchangeinfo == "yes"),
    pct_exchanged = round(100 * mean(exchangeinfo == "yes"))
  ) |>
  kable()
```

### Inferential statistics

> A chi-square test of independence indicated that participants were significantly less likely to reject the unattractive potential date in the real condition compared with the hypothetical condition, χ2(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009.

```{r}
#| label: analysis
tab <- table(d_tidy$condition, d_tidy$exchangeinfo)
tab

chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)  # no continuity correction, per report hint
chi

cat(sprintf("chi2(%d, N = %d) = %.2f, p = %.3f",
            chi$parameter, sum(tab), chi$statistic, chi$p.value))
```

For comparison, with the Yates continuity correction (R's default) the statistic would be different:

```{r}
#| label: analysis-yates
chisq.test(tab, correct = TRUE)
```

**Agent's summary:** Study 1 target reproduced. Counts (10/61 = 16% vs. 26/71 = 37%) and χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 match the paper exactly when the test is run without continuity correction. With Yates correction it would be χ² = 5.79, p = .016, so the paper evidently used the uncorrected Pearson test. Targets 2–4 (MANOVA, univariate ANOVAs, mediation) were outside the Part A scope set by `reproducibilityReport.Rmd` and were not attempted.
